title: funni tier tagger
description: this mod lets you see people's rankings on the funni tier list, kinda like tiertagger or something.
body:
# this project is highly experimental!
all this mod really does is add a prefix to tiered player's nametags using an api

this mod is somewhat similar to [tiertagger](https://modrinth.com/project/tiertagger) in how it works.

![tiers next to names](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/52388dc7e71253df8e020c8c0bdc9632ce84ed7d.png)

## commands
- /funnitiertagger <player>
  - queries the tiers of a uuid/playername
- /funnitiers <player>
  - ditto
- /funnitiertagger:clearcache
  - self explanatory
- /funnimode <gamemode>
  - lets you pick what gamemode to display/prioritize | also clears cache

## currently, there are 17 different funnitiers kits to be tested in:
- Wind Charge PvP
- Slime Mace
- Real Pot
- Pickaxe PvP
- Boxing
- Jousting
- Pressure Plate PvP
- Stone Age PvP
- Wooden SMP
- Dogs Out "PvP"
- "Modern" PvP
- Carrot PvP
- One-Shot PvP
- Wavemelon PvP
- Crystal;
- Wooden Spear
- Bow-Boost Mace

![example profile screenshot that shows all gamemodes and all tiers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/27d6917aca162769c141899cc3722032341074b9.png)

this tier list is supposed to be a less serious version of any other form of competitive mcpvp, so yeah have at it.
